description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 1899 (Kurunegala) for Itewa, Kotawehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of multiple land lots in Kurunegala District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, and the individuals or entities (including The State) to whom they are being settled. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its primary focus on land matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
